evidence.name: Steve

evidence.text: Aleem and us, had a very tight deadline, and despite that he was able to deliver. We are grateful for his work and understanding and cooperation.

evidence.text: He will be my go-to person for anything involving my websites and automations from here on out. Please give him a go!

evidence.text: Incredible work, highly suggest you work with this team. They brought the whole vision to life better than ever imagined!
